open: Which lift and stair serves platform 1/2 and which serves 3/4: no owner plan found. OSM's lifts are not linked to platforms, and OSM's platform refs at Skøyen (11, 12) are tram/bus stops, not the rail platforms.
Entrances: streets come from OSM only (Hoffsveien, Drammensveien); Bane NOR does not list the entrances.
Mix Skøyen hours are from OSM only; no owner page was readable.
No owner source says which stair leads to which platform.

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: Both platforms are reached by stairs and lift (Bane NOR: 'Trapper og heis til plattformer'). The 2023–24 modernisation is finished and all lifts and entrances are open. OSM has two lifts at the underpass but does not tag which platform each serves.
